the section names these vectors as the interim normative home until a permanent location in the x402 repository is agreed
encodes: The useful control from the text: two differently serialized artifacts with identical signed content. Both verify, their capture digests differ, and the signed-content identifier follows the declared recipe.
description: A scheme that signs typed fields, with a reference over the signed content, unchanged by member order or whitespace.
limits: This says the reference is stable across two serializations. It does not run the typed-data signature check itself.
